coastal.title: Trump pauses 50 per cent tariffs on Canadian goods for 3 days
coastal.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has announced he will pause the implementation of 50 per cent tariffs on a range of Canadian goods for three days, posting the decision less than two hours before the crushing levies were set to take effect.

coastal.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 18
coastal.description: Thousands of Summerland residents were given the go-ahead to return home on Tuesday as the district lifted the majority of evacuation orders related to the Bald Range fire.

coastal.title: Search for B.C.'s best roadside attraction: Southwest B.C. finals
coastal.description: Two natural wonders compete to represent the southwest in the Search for B.C.’s Best Roadside Attraction semifinals.

coastal.title: Coroner's inquest to begin for Tla-o-qui-aht Nation man fatally shot by RCMP
coastal.description: A coroner's inquest will begin today into the fatal shooting of a 28-year-old Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation man by Tofino RCMP in 2021, during what police described as a wellness check.

prince-george.title: ‘An existential threat’: B.C. businesses voice fears about looming U.S. tariffs
prince-george.description: As the U.S. 50-per-cent tariff deadline looms, some B.C. businesses are going into a tailspin of worry about the potential impacts it could have on their bottom line.

all.title: Jail guard appeared to sleep as Indigenous man died in cell: B.C. police watchdog
all.description: An IIO investigation found failures in how prisoners were monitored and cared for before an Indigenous man died by suicide in a Smithers RCMP cell.

all.title: Tumbler Ridge school teardown begins as B.C. prepares to rebuild following mass shooting
all.description: Demolition crews began work tearing down Tumbler Ridge Secondary School on Monday, about six months after a mass shooting. The province announced plans to replace the school 'as quickly as possible' in May, although a new location has yet to be announced.

all.title: Carney says last-minute U.S. tariff negotiations are 'delicate' and 'intense' as deadline looms
all.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney said last-minute negotiations with the U.S. to avoid a fresh batch of tariffs due to take effect this week are "delicate" and "intense," and he plans to speak to his American counterpart in the next 48 hours to broker a mutually agreeable deal.

all.title: How studying driver behaviour could make wildfire evacuations in northern B.C. safer
all.description: A UNBC PhD candidate is studying how drivers respond during simulated wildfire evacuations on Highway 97 north of Prince George. The research will help build a traffic model that could help emergency planners understand congestion, travel times and road closures before an evacuation happens.

all.title: Demand for Canadian citizenship certificates soaring, fuelled by Americans
all.description: Applications from people around the world seeking Canadian citizenship certificates have been rising rapidly, fuelled by thousands from the United States, CBC News has learned. So many people have applied following a change in the law that Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada says those who apply today could have to wait more than two years for a decision.

all.title: 'I felt like a sitting duck': B.C. mother recounts harrowing escape from scaffolding collapse in Regina
all.description: Claire Johnstone was loading her young son into her car when, all of a sudden, a scaffold came crashing down next to her car on Aug. 11. "It took me a second to realize that it was actually hitting the car," said Johnstone.
